independent_ledger_audit.scope: Only the complete actual candidate two-wave HTTP history. No arbitrary arrivals, unobserved workloads or performance grant.
independent_ledger_audit.evidence_limit: Complete source-bound device full-array bit/finite receipts, independently reconstructed IDs/schedule/route/tracing. Successful raw tensor payloads not retained; no offline arithmetic or tensor-byte reread.
independent_ledger_audit.private_source_binding: Actual qualifier clones original combined adapted/Handle constructor globals to the pinned server TraceGraph, whose delta policy is B1..8 candidate/zero fallback. Original replay arithmetic and restore are unchanged.

captured.call_binding: CPU case-step/direct label plus independently inferred within-step order; no explicit token-key receipt

replay.call_binding: CPU case-step/direct label plus independently inferred within-step order; no explicit token-key receipt

routes.call_binding: Independent semantic calls, consumed ahead skipped; no one-call-per-step or48-Python-calls-per-GPU assumption

independent_ledger_audit.tracing_scope: Observed per-layer Python tracing/eager deltas and same-key compiled reuse; no GPU kernel/completion count.

limitations: Sampled observations do not bound inter-sample allocation peaks or establish physical fit.
Known/native process inventories and repeated start-time assertions have source-bound saved scope; their full raw ps history is unavailable.
